title: Doesn't work on my little chainsaw. Smaller carbide bits would have been great.
text:
Doesn't work on my little chainsaw. Smaller carbide bits would have been great.. This Chainsaw Sharpener Kit would have been nice. I got it for a battery-powered chain saw. The bits are too large for it so I can not use it for the saw I got it for. I can, however, use it on the full-size chainsaw. Smaller carbide bits would have been very helpful to me.

The box comes with a piece that sets on top of the chain. It has screws to tighten it to the saw. Also included are 3 carbide bits, all three of the bits look similar in size. A handle to turn the carbide bits, some screws, and a wrench. Instructions are not included.

I will not be recommending this Chainsaw Sharpener Kit to family and friends.
